k.q: Calculate the combined sizes of two files from an array.
p: Change the final index from 2 to 1.
Extend the calculation to total all three file sizes. Why might a drive need additional capacity?
k.a: Initially 2+10=12 MB. Changing index 2 to 1 gives 2+6=8 MB. All three files total 18 MB. Real storage may need extra space for metadata, file-system overhead and future files.

e: Give one difference between compiler and interpreter. [3 marks]
Compiled source is translated to executable/intermediate output before execution of translated program; interpreted execution is mediated by an interpreter.
Explain how to make a program robust against invalid numeric input. [4 marks]
Use type/range checks; handle failure safely and request another value; test boundary/erroneous cases.

r: Explain the difference between RAM and virtual memory.
RAM is physical primary working memory; virtual memory uses secondary storage to back pages when RAM is insufficient.

stretch.task: Add a loop to calculate total file storage for [2,6,10] MB and compare it with the original two-file sum.
stretch.hint: Start totalMB=0 and traverse indexes 0 to 2.
stretch.answer: All three files total 18 MB. The original sum of first and third files was 12 MB.

mastery.task: Solve a combined problem: input a list, calculate its sum, locate the largest element and output the correct zero-based index, with tied maxima documented.
mastery.hint: Use single traversal, track total and maxIndex, decide whether the first tie wins.
mastery.answer: [2,6,10] -> sum18,max10,index2; [5,5] -> sum10,max5,index0 if only updating on >; empty list needs a defined policy.
